svg.title: How a new player is saved by itself
svg.desc: After the install, which signs nobody out, or a tap on Add account, which signs the page out, the extension waits ten minutes for a new account. The new player signs in on Autodarts. Each time an Autodarts page has finished loading, the extension looks for the session. Within the ten minutes, it saves the account once, the icon shows a check mark, and the player plays on. After the ten minutes, or once a player was saved, a sign-in is never saved by itself; the icon shows a plus, and Save account in the popup saves it.
